name: Salabladder
description: Its skin is thinner than paper. It hits hard, but it breaks at the very first blow it takes.
imageAlt: A salamander with a thin black crust over glowing molten rock, crawling low across a lava field with bright yellow eyes.

name: Scorpyro
description: It hides under the cooling crust and strikes only once, then withdraws to recharge. It fights for gratitude, not glory.
imageAlt: A scorpion of dark rock with lava glowing through its cracks, its stinger raised high above its back, on a field of molten rock.

name: Murlash
description: It grows only on ash still warm from an eruption, hurling glowing spores. Wherever it walks, life comes back.
imageAlt: A mushroom creature with a glowing orange cap, walking on twisted roots across volcanic ash and holding a flaming spear, glowing spores floating around it.

name: Embervix
description: So fast it outruns its own flames, it leaves a trail of sparks that confuses every enemy. Its paws are always burned.
imageAlt: A slender fox made of flames, with a long fiery tail, stepping down a dark rocky ridge streaked with lava.

name: Kobblor
description: It tunnels under the Arena and resurfaces behind the enemy. They say it once dug across an entire planet.
imageAlt: A pangolin covered in overlapping rock scales, with glowing molten claws, crawling out of cracked volcanic ground.

name: Bellowtusk
description: It fed a village forge until the lava took the village. It kept burning, and charges until the fire inside calms down.
imageAlt: An armored boar of dark rock plates with fire blazing inside its chest and between its plates, long curved tusks and burning eyes, charging forward.

name: Plumewyrm
description: Trained to dive from above, it breathes fire as it swoops and lands only where the ground is already burning.
imageAlt: A wyvern of dark rock and glowing magma diving from a red sky, breathing a stream of fire onto the burning ground below.

name: Basaltaur
description: Slow to start, it cracks the ground beneath its hooves once it charges. Once it runs, nothing can stop it.
imageAlt: A huge bull of black basalt plates veined with glowing lava, with curved golden horns, charging head down as rocks burst from under its hooves.

name: Varagma
description: Its scales cool and crack with every step. Its heat is so intense that even the Void can feel it.
imageAlt: A colossal Komodo dragon of cracked molten rock with green eyes, standing on a lava field and breathing out a burst of flame.

name: Sparkit
description: Hyperactive and noisy, it bites, then shocks you: its way of saying sorry. It never holds back, not even for a second.
imageAlt: A small ferret with fur of crackling yellow lightning, leaping forward with its mouth open and claws out.

name: Molver
description: It lives in copper veins and senses their currents. It surfaces where the enemy is weakest, sparking with every blow.
imageAlt: A mole with a pink snout and long whiskers, its huge claws glowing orange like hot copper as it breaks out of dark rock.

name: Ohmlet
description: It charges up by rolling across the ground, then releases a small jolt on impact.
imageAlt: A battery-shaped beetle wound with copper coils and capped with metal, crawling across wet ground as yellow sparks crackle around it.

name: Faradya
description: It swims through the air along the lightning. Some say the power grid was never built: it grew around it.
imageAlt: A pale ray gliding through a stormy sky, its wide wings and long tail traced with yellow lightning.

name: Purrcuit
description: It patrols the copper plains in perfect silence. Only its purr gives it away: a faint current running through the grid.
imageAlt: A sleek black cat traced with glowing blue circuit lines, wearing a golden collar, standing on a dark rock under a stormy sky.

name: Teslon
description: Calm and majestic, it leads the herds of the storm plains. It strikes with precise discharges, never brute force.
imageAlt: A majestic stag with great copper antlers, an electric arc crackling between them and lightning running along its body.

name: Arctalon
description: With lightning running along its feathers, it flies and hunts in sync with its allies. Every dive is calculated.
imageAlt: An eagle with a white head and dark purple-tinged wings crackling with yellow lightning, diving with its talons outstretched.

name: Movolth
description: It follows magnetic fields to find its way and hunts down anyone who flees, its trail of lightning lighting up the sky.
imageAlt: A large moth with black and purple wings patterned with eye-like circles, flying through a storm of yellow lightning.

name: Xendrax
description: Powered by a storm that never ends, it leaps faster than the eye. When you see the flash, the fight is already over.
imageAlt: A dark hare traced with violet light, leaping through rings of yellow lightning across a stormy plain.

name: Bicefex
description: Its two heads never get along: one attacks while the other watches. They argue mid-fight, so it is hard to predict.
imageAlt: A radioactive worm with two fanged heads, one roaring with its jaws wide open while the other keeps watch, rising from a glowing green swamp.

name: Mewtant
description: Its antennae sense the enemy's energy. Wary and unpredictable, it fights only when someone invades its space.
imageAlt: A dark purple striped cat with two glowing pink antennae and yellow eyes, stalking warily through radioactive ruins.

name: Uranura
description: Every drop it sheds is toxic. It never starts a fight, but nobody has ever touched it twice.
imageAlt: A fat toad covered in glowing green spots, toxic slime dripping from its skin, sitting on a rock in a radioactive swamp.

name: Geigerix
description: Its ears tick like a Geiger counter, faster as the enemy gets closer. It hunts in the dark, guided by radiation.
imageAlt: A giant bat with huge purple-veined ears and tattered wings, swooping out of the dark over a toxic swamp.

name: Beatler
description: Its residue weakens the ground wherever it goes. Its enemies may survive the fight, but rarely what remains afterward.
imageAlt: A beetle with a cracked green shell oozing glowing toxic slime, with red glowing eyes and antennae, crawling through a radioactive swamp.

name: Plumbelix
description: Its lead shell was carved deep in the mines, and light leaks from its cracks. Slow, but nearly impossible to wound.
imageAlt: A huge snail with a heavy shell of dark metal banded in gold, purple light leaking from its cracks, sliding through a toxic swamp.

name: Pluthorn
description: Its first blow wounds. The second comes later, when the radiation takes effect.
imageAlt: An armored rhino of cracked gray plates with a large glowing green plutonium horn, lowering its head to charge.

name: Cnidion
description: Powered by endless fission, it fights without moving. Its filaments fry anything that drifts into reach.
imageAlt: A purple jellyfish glowing green from within, floating above a radioactive swamp, long purple and green filaments trailing below it.

name: Isodile
description: Every hit seems to tear a piece away, but the missing piece keeps fighting on its own.
imageAlt: A colossal crocodile, half covered in scales and half bare skeleton, its jaws wide open as it wades through a radioactive swamp.

name: Shardskitter
description: It runs with no set direction, always at full speed. It comes from the icy comets farthest from any star.
imageAlt: A small dark comet shard scuttling on crystal legs across the ice, trailing a long glowing golden tail.

name: Azotol
description: Everything it touches freezes instantly. Fragile, but hard to hit: in its own mist, it is almost invisible.
imageAlt: A translucent white axolotl with golden feathery gills, its body dissolving into white vapor as it glides over icy cliffs.

name: Sleetseal
description: It slides across the ice at full speed and freezes all it touches. Underestimate it, and you end up stuck to the ice.
imageAlt: A frost-covered gray seal with icy whiskers, sliding fast across purple-lit ice with its mouth open in a snarl.

name: Methangler
description: It walks on its fins and lures prey with a glowing light. Whatever it catches never returns to the surface.
imageAlt: A dark anglerfish walking on its fins across the ice, its jaws full of sharp teeth, a glowing pink lure hanging from its head.

name: Carapax
description: It made its home in a fallen comet and raises its huge claws to defend it. It gives up its shelter to no one.
imageAlt: A hermit crab living in a spiral shell of ice, its huge claws banded with glowing green, charging across a frozen plain.

name: Driftsloth
description: It moves very slowly along the frozen ridges. Patient as ice itself, it lets the enemy wear itself out.
imageAlt: A huge white sloth with a coat of icicles and long crystal claws, climbing slowly over a frozen ridge.

name: Wolfrost
description: It chases its prey for weeks, in no hurry at all. It knows every crack in the ice.
imageAlt: A white ice wolf with spiky crystal fur, running across a frozen plain and kicking up a spray of frost.

name: Chelonice
description: It advances very slowly, and it is hard to scratch. Its breath freezes the ground ahead.
imageAlt: A gigantic tortoise carrying an entire glacier on its back, frozen breath streaming from its mouth across a cracked ice field.

name: Kryngeon
description: It strikes in silence, then rises, its jagged scales shattering the surface into a thousand blades.
imageAlt: A sea serpent made of jagged ice shards with glowing purple eyes, bursting out of a frozen sea as the surface shatters around it.

name: Antomator
description: When it loses a piece, it replaces it with the first scrap of metal it finds. Small and stubborn, it takes huge blows.
imageAlt: A mechanical ant of steel plates, gears and rivets, with a screw in place of one antenna, standing on a rocky red mining plain.

name: Leadlimbs
description: It adapts to any terrain and any enemy. Its strength is modest.
imageAlt: A spider of liquid chrome on very long, curved legs, towering over a red mining crater.

name: Rustshell
description: It raises its dented shell like a shield. It rarely strikes, but it withstands almost anything.
imageAlt: An old crab-shaped automaton covered in rust, with glowing yellow eyes, holding its dented domed shell over itself like a shield.

name: Vaultbug
description: Its plates open only to strike, and then nothing holds it back. Nobody knows what it guards, and it will never tell.
imageAlt: A heavily armored steel beetle with two curved horns, orange light glowing through the seams of its shell.

name: Brasstick
description: A core of unknown origin glows inside it. It stands guard for hours without moving and lets no one through.
imageAlt: A giant mechanical tick with a dark metal body, a glowing green core in its round back and long jointed legs.

name: Porcupole
description: It pulls toward itself the blows meant for its allies. A living shield, and proud of it.
imageAlt: A porcupine of dark steel quills edged in cyan light, with metal shards orbiting around it like a shield.

name: Hydrargus
description: It studies the enemy at length, then strikes, leaving drops of silver behind.
imageAlt: A great cat of polished liquid silver with glowing purple eyes, a crest of blades along its spine and a tail ending in a curved blade.

name: Steelink
description: It coils up before every strike. Each ring of its body moves on its own.
imageAlt: A steel serpent of jointed segments with blade-like fins and purple light between its plates, coiled and ready to strike.

name: Magnetark
description: It controls the magnetic fields of an entire planet. Metal obeys before it even knows it has been called.
imageAlt: A colossal metal kraken with a glowing magenta eye and tentacles lined with pink light, surrounded by an orbiting storm of metal shards.

name: Lumivora
description: Wherever it lands, darkness falls and enemies lose their bearings. It comes from forests no light has ever touched.
imageAlt: A moth with huge opaque black wings, resting on dark rock veined with faint golden light, almost invisible against the darkness.

name: Sootling
description: It slips into every crack and scratches with claws of ash. It annoys the enemy more than it hurts them.
imageAlt: A small spirit of black soot drifting like smoke, with two glowing pink eyes and clawed hands of ash.

name: Coalcurl
description: When threatened, it rolls up and waits. Hard to bring down, it wins by wearing the enemy out.
imageAlt: An armadillo of raw black coal curled almost into a ball, purple embers glowing in the cracks between its plates.

name: Hurcrick
description: Its spines suddenly stretch out in every direction. The glow at its center is the only part of it you can truly see.
imageAlt: A sea urchin of pure darkness on long thin legs, its spines stretched out in every direction around a glowing blue core.

name: Lurkamael
description: It moves from rock to rock unseen and strikes by surprise. Nobody remembers seeing it, which is just what it wants.
imageAlt: A chameleon of matte black carbon with a bright green eye, clinging to a dark rock and blending into the shadows.

name: Graphink
description: They say its ink writes the names of the fallen. It blinds its enemies with it, then strikes with its tentacles.
imageAlt: A dark cuttlefish with golden-edged fins and tentacles, floating in the air and trailing a cloud of glowing purple ink.

name: Noctopus
description: It comes from a world light never reached. It strikes before the enemy even knows it is being watched.
imageAlt: A shadow octopus emerging from the darkness, its black tentacles ending in curved golden hooks.

name: Murkpard
description: It commands its kind without ever raising its voice. It stalks low and slow, and pounces only when sure to hit.
imageAlt: An armored black panther with golden markings and glowing magenta accents, stalking low across dark rocks.

name: Umbrodon
description: It advances slowly but unstoppably. It reminds the Void of something familiar, and nobody knows why.
imageAlt: A colossal mammoth of black stone and shadow, violet cracks glowing across its body and huge obsidian tusks rimmed with green light.

name: Adamantis
description: It waits motionless, forelegs folded as if in prayer, then strikes once, cleanly. Nothing can crack it.
imageAlt: A mantis of clear diamond with prismatic, rainbow-edged blades, standing upright in a crystal cave, its forelegs folded as if in prayer.

name: Sapphenix
description: Elegant and hard to bring down, it soars over fields of giant crystals and strikes from above with precision.
imageAlt: A sapphire bird with spread wings and a long tail of blue gem feathers, flying over a field of giant crystals in a cave.

name: Arebyus
description: Stubborn as stone, it charges head-on and never yields. It was born where heat and pressure turn rock to crystal.
imageAlt: A ram of faceted red ruby with golden spiral horns, charging head-on and shattering rock in a glowing crystal cave.

name: Vulpaz
description: It stores light and releases it in blinding flashes. Cunning and patient, it would rather endure than rush in.
imageAlt: A topaz fox with a faceted golden body and a large tail of glowing amber crystals, standing in a crystal cave.

name: Basilith
description: Strong and ancient, it was born in a planet's core under immense pressure. Its faceted body breaks light into every hue.
imageAlt: A crowned dragon of faceted purple amethyst, standing in a cave full of amethyst crystals.

name: Emerlynx
description: Agile and silent, it was born in geode caves. Balanced between attack and defense, it adapts to any fight.
imageAlt: A translucent emerald lynx glowing green, crouched low on a crystal ledge in a dark geode cave, ready to pounce.

name: Xenopendra
description: Even its own kind keeps its distance. It strikes with a force no other creature can match.
imageAlt: An alien centipede made of glowing green xenon gas, with dozens of curved golden claws, rearing up in open space.

name: Stryxton
description: Mysterious and balanced, it watches everything and speaks little. It knows more than it says, and it knows it well.
imageAlt: An owl made of glowing cyan and white krypton gas, its wings spread wide and its golden eyes staring forward, in open space.

name: Pavoneon
description: Vain and dazzling, it fights only where someone is watching. Its blazing display leaves every enemy disoriented.
imageAlt: A peacock made of glowing orange neon gas, its tail fanned out with eye-like spots, rising through open space.

name: Lykadron
description: It howls before every attack, and it is proud of being unpredictable: nothing about it holds its shape for long.
imageAlt: A wolf made of glowing red radon smoke, howling, its body scattering into wisps against open space.

name: Drakelius
description: Born in the nebulae, it belongs to no world. Elusive, it always vanishes a moment before you can thank it.
imageAlt: A dragon made of glowing white and golden helium gas, its long body coiling through open space between galaxies.

name: Cetargos
description: Few things are harder to bring down. It protects every ship it stops on, but it has never explained why.
imageAlt: A colossal whale made of glowing purple argon gas, circled by thin rings of light, drifting through open space between galaxies.
